_about: Ethyl acetate (1) + acetic acid (2): isothermal total pressures (static method) at 323.15 K from Brandt et al. (2014). Rows: temperature in K (the set's constraint), liquid mole fraction of ethyl acetate, pressure in kPa as in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured in the same apparatus.

source.citation: S. Brandt, S. Horstmann, S. Steinigeweg, J. Gmehling, Phase equilibria and excess properties for binary systems in reactive distillation processes Part II. Ethyl acetate synthesis, Fluid Phase Equilib. 376 (2014) 48-54
source.access: Journal article is subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 6: acetic acid + ethyl acetate, vapour pressure, variable mole fraction of ethyl acetate (liquid), constraint T = 323.15 K. The table number in the article was not checked (article not open).

notes: Expanded uncertainties in the record: 0.06 to 0.18 kPa. validation/python/fit_parameters.py uses the pure-component rows as the vapour pressures of the isotherm. Values as stored in the ThermoML record (XML file), extracted with validation/python/thermoml_read.py; nothing converted or rounded. To be checked by a person against the record before use (AGENTS.md rule 4).
